title: feat: productize local capability workflows
body:
## AIP productization closure

- adds a persistent, Owner-scoped local provider registry with visible setup for STT, TTS, and screen vision
- routes registered providers into bounded voice/status and screen-vision execution paths
- adds explicit Companion Android loopback debug transport start/stop controls and the Android INTERNET permission
- preserves safe-mode, temporary-chat, confirmation, redaction, replay, and no-network boundaries
- aligns Phase 7B–7F, Voice, Tools, Extensions, Screen Vision, Android, and Gateway docs with honest product classifications
- adds the installed-Windows human smoke checklist

Validation: contracts 23 tests; desktop 59 tests; Rust 152 tests; cargo fmt/check/clippy; desktop typecheck; lint; secrets scan; web build; Python checks. Android Gradle validation remains pending because this host has no Java/JAVA_HOME.

Classifications remain explicit: EXTERNAL-PREREQUISITE PRODUCTIZED for Voice/Tools/Screen Vision, PRODUCTIZED for Extensions, PRODUCTIZED FOR DEBUG COMPANION for Android, and BACKEND-ONLY for Gateway. Final release approval still requires installed-Windows human smoke.
